description: This Java class 'ModelGrid' models the <grid> element in the OFBiz widget framework. It extends 'ModelForm' and provides mechanisms to load parent grid definitions, supporting inheritance and resource expansion. The class is designed to be immutable and used as a read-only data structure representing XML configuration.

classes.name: ModelGrid
classes.description: Represents a read-only model of a <grid> XML element, supporting inheritance and resource expansion within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: ModelGrid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModelGrid instance from an XML element and context objects.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor implementing ModelWidgetVisitor to perform operations on this ModelGrid instance.

methods.name: getParentModel
methods.description: Retrieves the parent grid model if inheritance is specified, handling resource expansion and local document search.
